purpose: Test venue/meeting portability of the same burned tactical opportunity protocol without using prior pooled rates to select tactical content.

external_schedule_basis_only.verified_only_for_prespec: Official schedule sources identify a Beppu FII morning meeting held 2026-08-16 through 2026-08-18. No tactical replay content, finish order, payout, odds, or candidate-model output was inspected to choose the meeting or race numbers.

selection_rule: Use final-day races R1 through R6 in sequential order, fixed before tactical inspection. Perform objective regime screening before tactical annotation. Any regime-ineligible race remains permanently burned once inspected for regime and may be replaced only by the next sequential race after R6 under a separately committed remediation written before reviewing the replacement tactically.

allowed_before_replay_binding: objective race-header regime screening after source binding
forbidden_before_pass_a: result pages used for tactical inference
existing tactical labels from another source
source_acquisition_firewall.reason: Official replay sources and immutable source manifests must be bound first; Pass A cannot begin from an unbound source.

comparison_plan.pooling_rule: Do not pool with Iwaki Taira until Batch4 Pass A and Pass B are locked and venue-specific counts/ranges are reported first.
comparison_plan.heterogeneity_note: Venue/meeting differences must remain visible; a pooled rate may not erase a materially different venue-specific diagnostic.

forbidden: using finish order as an annotation target
using prior pooled estimates to reinterpret ambiguous frames
promoting any diagnostic to Reality truth
terminal_rule: Batch4 is now fixed to Beppu final day 2026-08-18 R1-R6 before tactical inspection. No Pass A review may begin until official replay sources are bound with provenance and hashes under a later research-only record.
